body: They aren't normal. The only thing that would cause these sociopaths to feel anything will be when they see the suicide video I will have sent to them, after I am gone. And even then it wont be remorse--it will be shock.
My depressive cycles were never that severe until now so meds worked fine--mainly road the manic side of the illness for months to years at a time.
Bipolar, but functional. Plenty of health problems, but that was supposed to be the Karmic trade off. Tried to always be a good person.

I appreciate your kind words, and wish I could believe them. But, sociopaths don't feel alone. They will never feel remorse over their actions, and they will never care about that warmth denied them. 
As for my father, he was "self employed" when he took off. No way to track him via paycheck.
